rationale.headline: 10-year reviewed annual path; independent margin and capital schedules.
rationale.growthDuration: 9%/8%/7% early, then fade to 2.5% by year 10. Mature installed-base/device economics make 10 years sufficient for the reference; 15 years remains a conditional product/Services expansion bull, not default. Retain 10; no evidence requires 15–20 for the selected mature ecosystem case.
rationale.marginTimeline: Selected 31%/31.5%/32% reaches mature margin by year 3, independent of growth maturity.
rationale.capitalTimeline: Early S:C 2.5/2.5/3, middle 3; final-five-year fade to terminal economics. Outsourcing does not make economic capital free.
rationale.uncertainty: Three company-specific bounded triangular stress distributions for growth, margins and WACC; the investment multiplier is held fixed because it cannot represent annual capital-timing uncertainty. Independent draws and unmodeled risks are explicit.

parameterRationale.growth: Three-year base 9/8/7% starts below recent 16–17% growth and near September 9–11% outlook. Services and >2.5 bn active devices help; large hardware base, supply constraints and upgrade cyclicality argue against five years at 16%. Bull requires durable premium upgrades, Services growth and new products; bear tests stalled hardware cycle.
parameterRationale.years: 9%/8%/7% early, then fade to 2.5% by year 10. Mature installed-base/device economics make 10 years sufficient for the reference; 15 years remains a conditional product/Services expansion bull, not default. Retain 10; no evidence requires 15–20 for the selected mature ecosystem case.
parameterRationale.targetMargin: Current TTM 33.17% contains an approximate 47 bp Q 3 refund benefit. September underlying GM 46–47% plus rising R&D supports a first-year 31% EBIT margin rather than copying current quarterly highs. Recovery toward 32% requires memory pressure easing and Services mix.
parameterRationale.tax: Normalized operating-tax judgment rather than near-quarter 16.5% outlook, cash-tax timing or a one-time benefit. It avoids perpetuating a temporarily favorable reported rate.
parameterRationale.salesCapital: A ratio-based outsourced-manufacturing/ecosystem reinvestment model is the selected source. Revenue scaling is a practical intensity sensitivity; it does not recreate delta-sales divided by S:C and can miss supplier obligations and inventory cash shocks. The exact annual investment schedule is authoritative. Derived sales/capital is descriptive and is never charged a second time.
parameterRationale.wacc: Source scenarios 8.5%/9%/10.5% imply shifts-0.5/0/+1.5 pp. Base build:5.09% Treasury +4.5% ERP*beta 1.0,10% debt weight,0.7% debt spread,20% normalized tax gives 9.0942% unrounded, selected 9%. Beta/weights/spread are assumptions.
parameterRationale.terminalGrowth: Retain 2.5% nominal USD: approximately 0.49% real at a 2% inflation anchor intentionally describes slow mature expansion. Services supports persistence, but product replacement and scale warrant lower real growth than the diversified enterprise/cloud group.
parameterRationale.terminalROIC: Brand, ecosystem and outsourced capital support persistent excess returns; book ROIC is distorted by expensed intangibles and buybacks.20% is analyst judgment, not a measured incremental return.
parameterRationale.otherAssets: Use separately named, dated assets in the reviewed common-equity bridge. Carrying amounts are conditional value proxies; no unsourced scalar asset plug is inserted.
parameterRationale.otherClaims: Use separately named, dated debt and other claims in the reviewed bridge, once. Future FCFF deficits already reduce operating value and are not a second debt deduction. Unknown awards and contingencies remain disclosed.
parameterRationale.normalizationDelta: No rewrite of reported anchor EBIT. The annual margin path explicitly embeds the analytical forward normalization; SBC remains an economic cost. Forecast-only anchors do not acquire fabricated reported EBIT.
parameterRationale.timing: Forecast-origin valuation at 2026-06-27, using end-of-year discounting. Information as of 2026-10-17 is retrospective to that origin. October 17 as-of equity valuation requires the post-anchor operating stub and cash/debt/share roll-forward. Unknown stub FCFF remains null.
parameterRationale.claims: 84,118 of noncurrent securities is added once, outside the snapshot cash of 62,399. Debt uses exact 11,007 + 71,340 term debt + 1,997 commercial paper, not the rounded debt note. June finance leases are unavailable; the default 1,230 is an explicitly stale September 2025 carry-forward scenario. Existing employee-award value is unquantified; current common allocation does not assert fully diluted fair value. Conditional Globalstar redemption proceeds are unquantified and receive no incremental asset credit.
parameterRationale.currency: Nominal USD millions and decimal rates. No FX conversion or live quote is inferred.
parameterRationale.reinvestment: A ratio-based outsourced-manufacturing/ecosystem reinvestment model is the selected source. Revenue scaling is a practical intensity sensitivity; it does not recreate delta-sales divided by S:C and can miss supplier obligations and inventory cash shocks.
parameterRationale.marginTimeline: Selected 31%/31.5%/32% reaches mature margin by year 3, independent of growth maturity.
parameterRationale.capitalTimeline: Early S:C 2.5/2.5/3, middle 3; final-five-year fade to terminal economics. Outsourcing does not make economic capital free.
parameterRationale.annualTaxRates: Annual tax path: 20.0%; terminal 20.0%. Normalized operating-tax judgment rather than near-quarter 16.5% outlook, cash-tax timing or a one-time benefit. It avoids perpetuating a temporarily favorable reported rate.
parameterRationale.terminalTransition: Original terminal policy preserved. Final explicit revenue growth 2.500000%; terminal growth 2.500000%; terminal FCFF growth versus final explicit FCFF 2.144097%. No silent smoothing or extra capital subtraction.
parameterRationale.terminalReview: Analyst scenario judgment, not a Damodaran prescription or issuer forecast. Optional annual and terminal uncertainty is supported; the research default holds terminal growth fixed at the reviewed rate. Review date is not a new valuation date.

simulationRationale.classification: Subjective conditional scenario uncertainty, authored 2026-10-17. Ranges and frequencies are not empirically calibrated probabilities, stock-price forecasts, expected returns, or complete downside/funding probabilities.
simulationRationale.trials: Application policy dated 2026-10-18: fresh settings and explicit resets use 5,000 attempted scenarios. Saved counts stay unchanged until reset or Use research. This is a numerical sampling choice, not greater forecast confidence; dated research files retain their original counts.
simulationRationale.seed: Fixed ticker-specific seed 'aapl-research-2026-10-17-v1' makes the selected model reproducible. The seed was not selected for a preferred valuation result.
simulationRationale.binCount: 36 equal-width histogram bins are a display choice only; underlying draws and quantiles do not depend on the bin count.
simulationRationale.dependence: Independent stress draws are an explicit simplification, not measured economic independence. No evidence-backed company correlation matrix is available. Growth, margins and capital can co-move, so joint-tail results are incomplete; Fixed inputs have no defined correlation.
simulationRationale.capitalPolicy: A ratio-based outsourced-manufacturing/ecosystem reinvestment model is the selected source. Revenue scaling is a practical intensity sensitivity; it does not recreate delta-sales divided by S:C and can miss supplier obligations and inventory cash shocks. Revenue-scaled net investment means I[t]=selected I[t]*(shocked revenue[t]/selected revenue[t])*multiplier. This preserves investment intensity, not the original incremental sales-to-capital relationship. It is a disclosed approximation, not an identity.
simulationRationale.growthPremium: Year 1 scenario range 2%–13% versus selected 9% anchors -7/+4 pp. Growth is driven by a large installed base, Services and product replacement, with mature hardware concentration; do not annualize the recent 16%–17% product-cycle growth.
simulationRationale.marginShift: Persistent -3/+2 pp gives year 1 margins 28%–33% and terminal 29%–34%. This sits inside the broader mature 27.5%–35% scenario range while recognizing that the same shock applies immediately. Tariff refunds, memory costs and Services mix can move reported versus underlying margins; endpoints are own judgments, not a statistical interval.
simulationRationale.investmentMultiplier: Held fixed at 1 because this compressed model does not encode annual capex-path uncertainty. A uniform multiplier cannot preserve commissioning/depreciation timing, commitments and terminal-ROIC convergence. This is omitted uncertainty, not certainty about capex. Use the named source capital alternatives instead.
simulationRationale.waccShift: Source scenarios 8.5%/9%/10.5% imply shifts-0.5/0/+1.5 pp. Base build:5.09% Treasury +4.5% ERP*beta 1.0,10% debt weight,0.7% debt spread,20% normalized tax gives 9.0942% unrounded, selected 9%. Beta/weights/spread are assumptions.
simulationRationale.sampling: Analyst scenario judgment, not a Damodaran prescription or issuer forecast. Optional annual and terminal uncertainty is supported; the research default holds terminal growth fixed at the reviewed rate. Review date is not a new valuation date.
simulationRationale.constraints: Analyst scenario judgment, not a Damodaran prescription or issuer forecast. Optional annual and terminal uncertainty is supported; the research default holds terminal growth fixed at the reviewed rate. Review date is not a new valuation date.
simulationRationale.terminal: Analyst scenario judgment, not a Damodaran prescription or issuer forecast. Optional annual and terminal uncertainty is supported; the research default holds terminal growth fixed at the reviewed rate. Review date is not a new valuation date.
simulationRationale.fixedInputs: Analyst scenario judgment, not a Damodaran prescription or issuer forecast. Optional annual and terminal uncertainty is supported; the research default holds terminal growth fixed at the reviewed rate. Review date is not a new valuation date.
simulationRationale.distributionChoice: Chosen because the frozen research explicitly supplies bounded downside/base/upside narratives, and the selected source path is the most interpretable reference mode. Endpoints and density shape are subjective elicitation choices. This does not mean the endpoints bound all economically possible outcomes. Not chosen: no defensible standard deviation or Gaussian tail calibration is in the sources, and apparent numeric precision would be misleading. Not chosen: there is no case for equal plausibility across the entire range when a specifically reviewed central schedule exists. A lognormal can be sensible for multiplicative gross unit costs with an evidenced right tail. These factors scale NET investment, a difference between gross spending and depreciation plus working capital, and are derived from named bounded budget scenarios. No empirical net-investment lognormal is established. Bounded triangular is therefore a reasonable subjective stress parameter rather than merely an engine accommodation. Add cohort-level gross-cost lognormal support only if evidence supports it.

rationale.headline: 15-year reviewed annual path; company-specific uncertainty and source-dated capital constraints.
rationale.growthDuration: Five years cover N 2/A 14 and current overseas construction; ten additional years span several node generations while growth fades to 2% in year 15. Fifteen is supported by ecosystem and capital-cycle persistence, not brand alone. Twenty is unsupported; a ten-year compression is a separate stress, not the selected path. Preserve existing selected horizon; no automated 20-year extension.
rationale.marginTimeline: Margin reaches 46% in year 11 and stays there through year 15, earlier than growth maturity. Overseas dilution is already embedded; do not deduct the management 3–4 pp outlook again.
rationale.capitalTimeline: Early marginal S:C 1.30/1.25/1.20/1.15/1.10 fades to ~0.489 by year 15. Implied capex/D&A are an audit, not extra FCFF deductions; mature gross capex remains ~TWD 4.323 tr versus D&A 3.616 tr. In a full contraction stress preserve the source 8%-of-revenue positive investment floor. Preserve the neutral 1.751% terminal FCFF step.
rationale.uncertainty: Company-specific bounded triangular uncertainty is centered at the reviewed neutral scenario. Positive capital-factor uncertainty is a finite-horizon investment-intensity sensitivity, not a replacement-capex or funding forecast.

parameterRationale.growth: Bounds -8/+6 pp are conservative local 15-year path perturbations within source first-year bear/base/bull 15/30/40%. Using the entire -15 pp early difference across a slow fade would introduce an extended mid-horizon contraction not present in the selected path. Zero keeps 30/22/18/14/10% and the later node-cycle fade. Full Taiwan/disruption or source bear paths remain separate.
parameterRationale.years: Five years cover N 2/A 14 and current overseas construction; ten additional years span several node generations while growth fades to 2% in year 15. Fifteen is supported by ecosystem and capital-cycle persistence, not brand alone. Twenty is unsupported; a ten-year compression is a separate stress, not the selected path. Preserve existing selected horizon; no automated 20-year extension.
parameterRationale.targetMargin: Strict persistent shift -5/0/+2 pp gives first-year EBIT 52–59%, matching source first-year bear/bull 52/59% around base 57%; mature EBIT is 41–48%. Copying mature 37/52% endpoints to every year would imply 48/63% early EBIT, exceeding the separately designed early bull. Zero preserves 57/55/53/51/50% and subsequent fade. Node leadership supports profit, while overseas costs and utilization normalize independently. Full 37/52% mature scenarios remain separate; overseas dilution already embedded must not be charged twice.
parameterRationale.tax: 18%/19%/20% first-three-year operating cash tax then 20% is a selected normalization schedule, not a perpetual extrapolation of the latest effective rate. Grants are embedded once in capital economics.
parameterRationale.salesCapital: Early marginal S:C 1.30/1.25/1.20/1.15/1.10 fades to ~0.489 by year 15. parameterRationale.wacc: Bounds -1.5/+3 pp recover native TWD source 8.5/13% around 10%. parameterRationale.terminalGrowth: Retain 2.0% nominal TWD: approximately 0.49% real under the existing 1.5% long-run TWD inflation assumption. parameterRationale.terminalROIC: 2% nominal TWD perpetual growth is currency-specific, consistent with assumed long-run TWD inflation 1.5% and modest real growth; not a USD guidance transcription. 18% ROIC supports a durable but fading foundry moat and requires 11.111% terminal NOPAT reinvestment.
parameterRationale.otherAssets: Use separately named, dated assets in the reviewed common-equity bridge. Carrying amounts are conditional value proxies; no unsourced scalar asset plug is inserted.
parameterRationale.otherClaims: Use separately named, dated debt and other claims in the reviewed bridge, once. Future FCFF deficits already reduce operating value and are not a second debt deduction. Unknown awards and contingencies remain disclosed.
parameterRationale.normalizationDelta: No rewrite of reported anchor EBIT. The annual margin path explicitly embeds the analytical forward normalization; SBC remains an economic cost. Forecast-only anchors do not acquire fabricated reported EBIT.
parameterRationale.timing: Forecast-origin valuation at 2026-09-30, using end-of-year discounting. Information as of 2026-10-17 is retrospective to that origin. October 17 as-of equity valuation requires the post-anchor operating stub and cash/debt/share roll-forward. Unknown stub FCFF remains null.
parameterRationale.claims: All outputs remain native TWD per ordinary share. No USD ticker or ADS conversion is inferred. IFRS lease debt treatment assumes matching lease D&A/reinvestment in supplied FCFF; do not also deduct lease principal from the same FCFF. Customer receipt claim must not duplicate repayment or receivable-offset costs already in operating working capital. September lease and customer-receipt balances are missing. Default 35,428 and 291,101.8 are explicit FY2025 carry-forward sensitivities, not verified September liabilities. Long investments of 224,633 mix operating/equity-method and financial assets; default no incremental credit avoids assuming they are all nonoperating. 25,932 million ordinary shares is issuer-rounded. Current award claims are unquantified. No valuation-date spot FX has been verified. USD ADS output remains blocked; flow-average FX is not a substitute.

simulationRationale.classification: Subjective conditional scenario uncertainty, authored 2026-10-17. Ranges and frequencies are not empirically calibrated probabilities, stock-price forecasts, expected returns, or complete downside/funding probabilities.
simulationRationale.trials: Application policy dated 2026-10-18: fresh settings and explicit resets use 5,000 attempted scenarios. Saved counts stay unchanged until reset or Use research. This is a numerical sampling choice, not greater forecast confidence; dated research files retain their original counts.
simulationRationale.seed: Fixed ticker-specific seed 'tsm-research-2026-10-17-v1' makes the selected model reproducible. The seed was not selected for a preferred valuation result.
simulationRationale.binCount: 36 equal-width histogram bins are a display choice only; underlying draws and quantiles do not depend on the bin count.
simulationRationale.dependence: Independent stress draws are an explicit simplification, not measured economic independence. No evidence-backed company correlation matrix is available. Growth, margins and capital can co-move, so joint-tail results are incomplete; Fixed inputs have no defined correlation.
simulationRationale.capitalPolicy: Revenue-scaled annual investment multiplies each source amount by scenario revenue / source revenue, then by the selected investment factor. This preserves net-investment/revenue intensity, not incremental sales/capital, and is not a verified gross-capital or funding model.
simulationRationale.growthPremium: Bounds -8/+6 pp are conservative local 15-year path perturbations within source first-year bear/base/bull 15/30/40%. Using the entire -15 pp early difference across a slow fade would introduce an extended mid-horizon contraction not present in the selected path. Zero keeps 30/22/18/14/10% and the later node-cycle fade. Full Taiwan/disruption or source bear paths remain separate.
simulationRationale.marginShift: Strict persistent shift -5/0/+2 pp gives first-year EBIT 52–59%, matching source first-year bear/bull 52/59% around base 57%; mature EBIT is 41–48%. Copying mature 37/52% endpoints to every year would imply 48/63% early EBIT, exceeding the separately designed early bull. Zero preserves 57/55/53/51/50% and subsequent fade. Node leadership supports profit, while overseas costs and utilization normalize independently. Full 37/52% mature scenarios remain separate; overseas dilution already embedded must not be charged twice.
simulationRationale.investmentMultiplier: Low 0.8667x/high 1.4444x compare initial selected 1.3x marginal S:C with source bull 1.5x/bear 0.9x; mode 1 retains selected intensity. These bounds test capital efficiency and tooling/foreign-fab cost, not nominal gross capex guidance. Later source ratios differ, so this is a local capital-intensity stress.
simulationRationale.waccShift: Bounds -1.5/+3 pp recover native TWD source 8.5/13% around 10%. Source base USD build 11.3182% translates using assumed USD/TWD inflation 2.5/1.5% to TWD 10.2322%, rounded to 10%. Beta 1.2, 10% debt, 1.5% spread/extra equity risk are judgments. It is not a directly observed TWD sovereign yield.
simulationRationale.sampling: Analyst scenario judgment, not a Damodaran prescription or issuer forecast. Optional annual and terminal uncertainty is supported; the research default holds terminal growth fixed at the reviewed rate. Review date is not a new valuation date.
simulationRationale.constraints: Analyst scenario judgment, not a Damodaran prescription or issuer forecast. Optional annual and terminal uncertainty is supported; the research default holds terminal growth fixed at the reviewed rate. Review date is not a new valuation date.
simulationRationale.terminal: Analyst scenario judgment, not a Damodaran prescription or issuer forecast. Optional annual and terminal uncertainty is supported; the research default holds terminal growth fixed at the reviewed rate. Review date is not a new valuation date.
simulationRationale.fixedInputs: Analyst scenario judgment, not a Damodaran prescription or issuer forecast. Optional annual and terminal uncertainty is supported; the research default holds terminal growth fixed at the reviewed rate. Review date is not a new valuation date.
simulationRationale.distributionChoice: Bounded triangular distributions express explicit downside, central mode and upside judgments from the reviewed scenarios. These are not empirically fitted probabilities.
